notes: Ensure that the refactoring strictly adheres to rule-based criteria and avoids any subjective judgment.

steps.details: Examine the existing codebase to understand how the current reviewer logic is implemented and identify areas where opinion-based decisions are made.

Create a JSON file that outlines the explicit pass/fail criteria: (1) all plan steps must be completed, (2) no execution issues allowed, (3) required sections must exist for documentation tasks, (4) improvements must be measurable vs previous version.

Refactor the reviewer code to replace opinion-based logic with rule-based logic. Use the criteria defined in 'reviewer/rules.json' to determine approval or 'revise' status. Ensure that the logic checks for completion of all plan steps, absence of execution issues, presence of required documentation sections, and measurable improvements.

steps.description: Add functionality to return specific actionable fixes
steps.details: Enhance the reviewer logic to provide specific actionable fixes when returning 'revise'. This should include detailed feedback on which criteria failed and how to address them.
Run the test suite to ensure that the refactored reviewer logic works as expected. Verify that the rule-based system correctly approves or returns 'revise' based on the defined criteria.

steps.description: Document the new rule-based approval system
steps.details: Create a documentation file explaining the new rule-based approval system. Include sections on the criteria used, how the system determines approval or 'revise', and examples of actionable fixes. The tone should be technical and detailed.
